needs_ledger.plain: MAGA INC. file 2010907 is saved: two $5 million independent expenditures to Del Ray Media LLC.
Alex Pfeiffer posted the High Tax Talarico statement with the ads on September 5.
The $10 million is the FEC filing, not an ad tracker. No AdImpact figure was admitted because the filing already carries the amount.

needs_ledger.plain: No Trump post naming the $10 million Texas buy was found. Friday remarks about MAGA Inc. money are quoted by the Associated Press.

needs_ledger.need: Most recent FEC quarterly totals for each candidate
needs_ledger.plain: July quarterlies through June 30 are on the FEC candidate pages.

needs_ledger.need: Public poll cited by coverage, with sponsor, dates, sample
needs_ledger.plain: UT/Texas Politics Project August 5-13, 1,200 registered voters, MOE 2.83 percent / 3.58 percent weighted.

needs_ledger.need: White House transcript of Friday MAGA Inc. remarks
needs_ledger.plain: No White House transcript was saved. The AP quotation is the record used.
needs_ledger.status: missing: no White House transcript saved this session

needs_ledger.need: White House pool of Friday MAGA Inc. remarks
needs_ledger.plain: The September 4 in-town pool is saved. Trump said the super PAC already spent and claimed close to a billion dollars.
The Texas Tribune quotation of AdImpact is saved. AdImpact's own table was not.

needs_ledger.need: Texas SOS certified Senate candidates and November 3
needs_ledger.plain: The Candidate Bio Portal capture for the 2026 November general and U.S. Senate lists Talarico, Paxton, and Brown as candidates in the general. Simmons is rejected as independent and accepted as write-in.
Paxton's Saturday post is saved. The Talarico campaign statement is the Associated Press copy of JT Ennis. Talarico's same-day post does not name the buy.
MAGA Inc. posted two ads on X on September 5. Full spoken transcripts of the videos are not in the text copies.
The March 11 Georgia special notice and CSV are saved, as is the August 24 Graham runoff notice.

needs_ledger.plain: The September 8 bulk file is saved and recounted for general-election totals.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: AP $10 million and Saturday filing check out; television matches connected TV. CBS donation and Del Ray Inc. are wrong against the notice. Fox Tribune $72 million and $16.8 million check out against the July 20 tracker. The Hill gift-to-campaign wording is wrong. NBC more than $400 million checks out against $403,450,026.85.
